segments.text: Lesson 21
segments.translation: 第21课

segments.text: Daniel Mendoza
segments.translation: 丹尼尔·门多萨

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: How many unsuccessful attempts did Mendoza make before becoming Champion of all England?
segments.translation: 门多萨在成为全英冠军之前曾有过几次失败的尝试？

segments.text: Boxing matches were very popular in England two hundred years ago.
segments.translation: 200年前，拳击比赛在英国非常流行。

segments.text: In those days, boxers fought with bare fists for prize money.
segments.translation: 在那时，拳击手们为了争夺奖金而赤手空拳地搏斗。

segments.text: Because of this, they were known as 'prizefighters'.
segments.translation: 因此，他们被称为“职业拳击手”。

segments.text: However, boxing was very crude, for there were no rules and a prizefighter could be seriously injured or even killed during a match.
segments.translation: 然而，当时的拳击非常粗野，因为没有任何规则，职业拳击手在比赛中可能受重伤甚至丧命。

segments.text: One of the most colourful figures in boxing history was Daniel Mendoza, who was born in 1764.
segments.translation: 拳击史上最引人注目的的人物之一是丹尼尔·门多萨，他出生于1764年。

segments.text: The use of gloves was not introduced until 1860, when the Marquis of Queensberry drew up the first set of rules.
segments.translation: 直到1860年昆斯伯里侯爵制定了第一套规则，才开始使用手套。

segments.text: Though he was technically a prizefighter, Mendoza did much to change crude prizefighting into a sport, for he brought science to the game.
segments.translation: 虽然从技术上讲，他是一个职业拳击手，但门多萨为将粗野的职业拳击变为一项运动做了大量工作，因为他将科学带入了这项比赛。

segments.text: In his day, Mendoza enjoyed tremendous popularity.
segments.translation: 在他那个时代，门多萨享有极高的声誉。

segments.text: He was adored by rich and poor alike.
segments.translation: 富人和穷人都同样崇拜他。

segments.text: Mendoza rose to fame swiftly after a boxing match when he was only fourteen years old.
segments.translation: 门多萨在14岁时的一次拳击比赛后迅速成名。

segments.text: This attracted the attention of Richard Humphries who was then the most eminent boxer in England.
segments.translation: 这引起了当时英国最著名的拳击手里查德·汉弗莱斯的注意。

segments.text: He offered to train Mendoza and his young pupil was quick to learn.
segments.translation: 他主动提出培训门多萨，他的年轻弟子学得很快。

segments.text: In fact, Mendoza soon became so successful that Humphries turned against him.
segments.translation: 事实上，门多萨很快就变得非常成功，以至于汉弗莱斯反过来反对他。

segments.text: The two men quarrelled bitterly and it was clear that the argument could only be settled by a fight.
segments.translation: 两人争吵得很厉害，显然只有通过决斗才能解决争端。

segments.text: A match was held at Stilton, where both men fought for an hour.
segments.translation: 比赛在斯蒂尔顿举行，两人搏斗了一个小时。

segments.text: The public bet a great deal of money on Mendoza, but he was defeated.
segments.translation: 公众在门多萨身上押了大量的赌注，但他被打败了。

segments.text: Mendoza met Humphries in the ring on a later occasion and he lost for a second time.
segments.translation: 后来，门多萨在拳击场上再次与汉弗莱斯相遇，他又一次输了。

segments.text: It was not until his third match in 1790 that he finally beat Humphries and became Champion of England.
segments.translation: 直到1790年的第三次比赛，他才终于击败了汉弗莱斯，成为了全英冠军。

segments.text: Meanwhile, he founded a highly successful Academy and even Lord Byron became one of his pupils.
segments.translation: 同时，他创办了一家非常成功的拳击学院，甚至拜伦勋爵也成了他的弟子。

segments.text: He earned enormous sums of money and was paid as much as ￡100 for a single appearance.
segments.translation: 他赚了大笔的钱，出场一次的报酬高达100英镑。

segments.text: Despite this, he was so extravagant that he was always in debt.
segments.translation: 尽管如此，他生活极其奢侈，以致总是负债累累。

segments.text: After he was defeated by a boxer called Gentleman Jackson, he was quickly forgotten.
segments.translation: 在他被一个名叫“绅士杰克逊”的拳击手击败后，他很快就被遗忘了。

segments.text: He was sent to prison for failing to pay his debts and died in poverty in 1836.
segments.translation: 由于无力偿还债务，他被关进了监狱，并于1836年在贫困中死去。
